archive_path.description: Path to the zpaq archive file.

command.description: The zpaq command to run: add, extract, or list.

dest_path.description: Destination path. For 'add', this is used as the -index file. For 'extract', this is used as the -repack archive or -to prefix.

exclude_patterns.description: List of patterns to exclude. Each pattern gets --not prepended.

include_patterns.description: List of patterns to include. Each pattern gets --only prepended.

password.description: Password for encryption/decryption. If empty, no -key option is added.

sources.description: List of file or directory names to add/extract/list.

summary_count.description: Summary count for -s option. Empty disables -s.

test.description: If true and command is extract, add -test flag.

threads.description: Number of threads to use. 0 uses default (number of cores).
